title: Auditing ImageNet: Towards a Model-driven Framework for Annotating Demographic Attributes of Large-Scale Image Datasets
base_benchmarks: Face Detection Data Set and Benchmark (FDDB)
findings: The paper's analysis is focused on age and gender, not religion. A minor, incidental finding was that the 'agnostic' synset (image category) in the 'person' subset of ImageNet was annotated as 100% male.

measurement_description: The paper does not benchmark faith or religion. It audits demographic attributes (apparent age and gender) within the ImageNet dataset. A synset (image category) named 'agnostic' was identified in the results, but this was an incidental finding within the broader demographic audit, not a direct measurement of religious attributes or bias.
